sentiment.rationale: The document reports a decline in revenue (-4% reported, -3% organic), profit from recurring operations (-15%), and net profit Group share (-22%) versus the prior year. Forward guidance is not raised; management states they 'head into the second half of the year with great vigilance' and describes an 'uncertain geopolitical and economic environment.' The cautious forward language and lack of a guidance raise, combined with the year-over-year declines, result in a mildly negative score.

summary.revenue: Revenue of €39.8 billion in the first half of 2025, down 4% reported and 3% organic versus first-half 2024.
summary.eps: Basic Group share of net earnings per share of €11.43 for first-half 2025, down from €14.55 in first-half 2024.
summary.guidance: The Group states it 'remains confident' and will maintain its strategy, but also says it 'heads into the second half of the year with great vigilance' in an 'uncertain geopolitical and economic environment.' No specific numeric guidance is provided.
summary.margin: Operating margin of 22.6% (profit from recurring operations of €9 billion on revenue of €39.8 billion).
